exists.quote: There is created within the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety a Certified Psychoanalysts Advisory Committee which shall serve as an advisory body to the director with respect to the State certification of psychoanalysts.

name.quote: "Advisory committee" means the Certified Psychoanalysts Advisory Committee established pursuant to section 4 of this act.

national_association.quote: "National psychoanalytic association" means a national professional organization of psychoanalysts that conducts on-site visits of psychoanalytic institutes applying for association membership.

regulatory_model.quote: "State certified psychoanalyst" means an individual who has met the eligibility requirements contained in section 6 of this act and holds a current, valid certificate of State certification.

definition_quote.value: Psychoanalytic services means therapeutic services that are based on an understanding of the unconscious and how unconscious processes affect the human mind as a whole, including actions, thoughts, perceptions and emotions.
